column1: # Lines the review packet's secret scan matches that were REVIEWED as not credentials.
# <reason> TAB <the whole source line, exactly>. build-security-review-packet.sh drops a
# hit only when its entire line equals one listed here (a diff's leading +, - or space
# ignored): a secret added to such a line changes the line and is scanned again. Never
# a pattern, never a partial line. Each entry names why the value is not a credential.
code: the awk program that rewrites the DB_PASSWORD line; the value comes from ENVIRON, never the text
column2: content=$(NEWPW=$new awk '/^DB_PASSWORD=/ { print "DB_PASSWORD=" ENVIRON["NEWPW"]; n++; next } { print } END { exit n == 1 ? 0 : 3 }' "$env") \
